div.div: Who reports to who: the leads report to the PM every week (status report C02), and the PM reports to the steering committee every two weeks (C01). Any change to scope, cost or schedule goes to the CCB (C05). The RACI on page 7 shows there is only one Accountable person for each deliverable.
